async def act(page):
    # Click the Filters button to open the filter panel
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Filters").click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for filter panel to appear
    
    # Locate the status filter combobox; assuming it has name 'Status' based on common Magento Admin patterns
    status_filter = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status")
    # Set the status to 'Processing'
    await status_filter.select_option("processing")
    
    # Apply the filter by clicking the 'Apply Filters' button (assuming it appears in the filter panel)
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Apply Filters").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Retrieve the table content as-is without any processing
    table = page.get_by_role("table")
    table_content = await table.inner_text()
    
    # Return the raw table content as the result
    return table_content
